performance.slow_performance: lag, slow performance or poor responsiveness
performance.processing_capability: processor/graphics ability to handle tasks or games

battery.charging: charging speed, charger or charging failure

display.screen_quality: resolution, brightness, color or display quality
display.screen_size: screen size or usable viewing area

audio.low_volume: speaker volume too low or too loud

input_devices.touchpad_mouse: built-in touchpad, cursor or pointer experience

connectivity_ports.printer_connection: computer fails to connect to a printer
connectivity_ports.usb_other_ports: USB, SD-card, HDMI and other physical ports

build_quality.hinge_assembly: hinge, adjacent plastic cracking, or screen-motion resistance from one hinge defect
build_quality.housing_damage: casing, chassis, lid or physical damage
build_quality.sticker_residue: packaging sticker or adhesive residue on chassis
build_quality.durability: other concrete materials or durability concern

design_portability.appearance: appearance, color, thinness and design aesthetics

price_value.value_for_money: value relative to what the product offers

purchase_service.listing_accuracy: misleading seller listing or stated specifications
purchase_service.return_warranty: returns, warranty, or repair service event

other.other_specific: specific and supported issue not covered above; flagged for review
